title: The GPU executes weights (0, 2/3, 1/3) on the three bone slots; slot 0's transform is computed and discarded
author: hypothesis lane, 2026-07-31
_fixtureNote: The finding that superseded the one in skin-weight-2026-07-31-as-written.json, transcribed from the note that killed it. It is here as the control arm of the self-test: a checker that rejects the wrong finding is worthless if it also rejects the right one, so this must reach SURVIVED, and the mutation tests perturb THIS record one field at a time to prove every rule can fail.

claim.statement: The linked vertex shader executes p' = 2*T[s1]*p + 1*T[s2]*p, so the weights the GPU applies to (slot0, slot1, slot2) are (0, 2/3, 1/3).

scope.population: every vertex shader the game handed D3D in the sampled sessions, and the skinned draws in level 800
scope.covered: 144 shaders created across 3 sessions and 2 levels; all 6 that use a c[a0.x+N] palette; 467 runtime vertices of the two Sentinel tentacle meshes
notCovered: the five infantry meshes, decoded and carrying the same slot structure but never caught on screen
whether the asymmetry is a bug or an intended convention - the two readings are observationally identical except on ABA vertices

rivals.statement: A bone's weight is the number of slots naming it divided by three, so the three slots are summed symmetrically and scaled by 1/3.
indistinguishableOn: the four diag(1/3) immediates at VA 0x00502ECF/0F06/0F3D/0F74
every uploaded palette row having norm 1/3
zero BAA or XYY across all 944 shipped two-bone vertices
the AAA and AAB slot patterns, on which the two laws give identical results

discriminator.description: the destination registers of the linked shader's second dp4 block, and the registers the accumulator is seeded from
discriminator.expectedUnderClaim: block 2 writes r0.x/.y/.z again (dst tokens 80010000/80020000/80040000, the same as block 1) and the accumulator seeds with add r1, r0, r0 (both source tokens 80E40000), so block 1's result is dead and slot 1 is doubled
discriminator.expectedUnderRival: block 1's result is preserved in a distinct register and each of the three blocks contributes exactly once to the sum

rivals.statement: Skinning is performed on the CPU and the pose lives in vertex data that is rewritten every frame.
indistinguishableOn: the presence of per-frame buffer traffic in the capture
the decoded bind pose matching the drawn silhouette

discriminator.description: lock count and content digest of the skinned vertex buffer across 60 frames
discriminator.expectedUnderClaim: unlocks=1 and one single FNV-1a-64 digest for all 60 frames, with a fixed vertex count
discriminator.expectedUnderRival: the buffer is re-locked each frame and its digest changes, as the CPU writes a new pose

predictions.statement: if the weights are carried by the palette scale, every linear row of every uploaded bone matrix has norm exactly 1/3
predictions.procedure: log every SetVertexShaderConstantF write with the proxy wrapper and take the norm of each linear row of c10..c51
predictions.wouldFalsifyIf: any row norm at 1/2 or 1, which would mean the weights are 50/50 or carried somewhere other than the palette
predictions.statedAt: SKIN-WEIGHT-LAW-2026-07-31.md, 'The test that would still overturn it', written before the capture ran

predictions.statement: if skinning is GPU-side, the runtime vertex buffer is the shipped bind pose unchanged
predictions.procedure: dump the runtime vertices behind the fvf=0x15A draws and compare every field against the decoded asset
predictions.expected: 0 position mismatches above 1e-3, and a fixed vertex count per mesh
predictions.wouldFalsifyIf: any nonzero mismatch count, or a vertex count that changes between frames
predictions.statedAt: capture plan for vskin-lvl800-20260731-133529, written before the run
predictions.observed: 0/234 and 0/233; bounds bit-for-bit equal to the decoded bind pose on all six extremes

predictions.statement: the stored slot word is the bone index times three, because the palette stride per bone is three registers
predictions.procedure: for every dumped runtime vertex, check the raw slot words against the asset's BONE index
predictions.expected: every slot word an exact multiple of 3, and word/3 equal to the asset's BONE index
predictions.wouldFalsifyIf: any slot word that is not a multiple of 3, or a word/3 that does not name the asset's bone
predictions.statedAt: SKIN-WEIGHT-LAW-2026-07-31.md, which derived the x3 stride from the c10 palette base

predictions.statement: the superseded note's four byte predictions reproduce on an independent re-read of the pristine specimen
predictions.procedure: re-read 0x1DC680, VA 0x004B0390 and the four immediates without consulting the earlier note's recorded values
predictions.expected: ab aa aa 3e; d8 25 80 c6 5d 00; four movs at stack offsets 0x174/0x188/0x19C/0x1B0
predictions.wouldFalsifyIf: any read that differs, which would mean the earlier note's byte table was wrong and this one inherited it
predictions.observed: all confirmed; the dword 0x3EAAAAAB occurs 9 times in the whole image

evidence.instrument: tools/d3d9-proxy isolated copy, sha256 6DDB1E67BE87B79BC1B7A2AFF8C503237299459766CD017C1AB86E0380FD0514, CreateVertexShader token-stream wrapper, BEA_D3D9_SHADERS=1
evidence.summary: complete token streams of every shader the game created; 6 of 144 carry a relatively-addressed palette and all 6 have the identical block

sample.units: linked shaders carrying a c[a0.x+N] palette, out of 144 created

evidence.instrument: SetVertexShaderConstantF wrapper in the same proxy build
evidence.summary: c10..c51 is 42 registers = 14 bones x 3, matching m_Sentinel Arm Big's 14-entry BONE array; every linear row is a rotation scaled by 1/3

evidence.instrument: proxy vertex readback, gate VFvf=346 VMinVerts=200, capture vskin-lvl800-20260731-133529
evidence.summary: runtime vertices behind the only blend-weight FVF in the whole capture corpus; unlocks=1 and a single digest across 60 frames, reproduced in a second independent session at different addresses

evidence.instrument: byte reads by hand, verified at read time
evidence.summary: independent re-read of the superseded note's byte table

residuals.statement: the runtime vertex buffer is not proven byte-identical to the asset: every printed field of all 467 vertices agrees and the bounds agree exactly, but the FNV-1a-64 over the asset's own 48-byte records does not equal the proxy's over the runtime bytes; normal renormalisation at load is the obvious candidate
the translation column being scaled by 1/3 is inferred from behaviour (applying the captured palette reproduces a coherent tentacle of the right size) rather than read directly
only the Sentinel tentacles were observed being drawn; if the infantry path uses a different palette base or FVF, the draw mapping is untested for them
c86..c94 are not identified; they are the lighting/fog/eye constants the later part of the shader consumes
bug versus intended convention on the ABA pattern is undecided; there is no ground truth for which bone the artist meant to dominate

poisonControl.description: the same logger, on the 138 shaders that are not the skinning shader, and on a level-611 session that links the skinning shader but draws no skinned mesh
poisonControl.predictedOutcome: the palette block is reported for 6 shaders only, and level-611 frames are reported with zero fvf=0x15A draws; if the logger reported the block everywhere, or reported a skinned draw where there was none, it would be fabricating and none of its clean readings would mean anything
poisonControl.observedOutcome: 6 of 144 carried the block; level 611 linked the shader and the sampled frames contain no fvf=0x15A draw at all

overturnedBy.procedure: patch the shipped shader's second-block destinations from r0 to r1 and the seeding add r1, r0, r0 to add r1, r0, r1 - a six-dword edit inside CreateVertexShader, same instruction count, restoring the pre-link IR's intended three-term sum - then capture the same level-800 frame with and without
overturnedBy.wouldShow: if the rendered tentacle is identical, slot 0 is contributing already and the dead-block reading is wrong, and the whole reversal falls; if it changes by roughly the predicted 0.28-unit mean / 0.86-unit peak, the executed weights are (0, 2/3, 1/3)
overturnedBy.cost: the proxy already sees pFunction, so this needs no game patch

overturnedBy.procedure: find any linked shader anywhere in the game whose skinning block seeds the accumulator with mov r1, r0 after block 1
overturnedBy.wouldShow: six out of six do not; a seventh that does would mean the linker's output is context-dependent and the law is not uniform
overturnedBy.cost: cheap - a scan of shaders already captured plus more levels
